Engagement: Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact. Reports to: Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

About tl;dv

We are building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house). You know the category patterns - and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you've got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).
  • Bonus Points if You have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results.
  • Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal – your role – outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance.

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

Data Analyst: A/B-tests and customer onboarding (Remote)

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents.

Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

About the Data Science Integrations team

Providing measurable KPI lifts is the goal of our platform, and most customers want to prove it running an A/B-test against either an in-house solution or one of our competitors. The Data Science Integrations team ensures that we run successful A/B tests at scale while minimizing manual engineering effort.

The team owns the customer onboarding process from a data quality standpoint, verifies the quality of customer integrations and tracking, and ensures that Constructor algorithms work as expected when ramping out tests to live customers. As a member of the Data Science Integrations team, you will use world-class analytical, engineering and data processing techniques to build the foundational infrastructure, tooling and analytical capabilities to enable the business to move forward.

Challenges you will tackle

  • Take initiative and perform data exploration to understand user behavior, suggest opportunities for improving our recommender & search systems, and implement pipelines for data delivery, as well as UX/UI changes
  • Ideate and deliver analytical insights to merchandizers to enable effective decision making and provide the best possible results during evaluation
  • Help the Customer Success team to communicate with merchandizers, fulfill their needs during integration, and provide best results for online metrics
  • Collaborate with the Customer Integrations team to make sure customers are integrated without bugs and with sufficient tracking to power data pipelines and models for search engine

Requirements

  • You are proficient in BI tools (data analysis, building dashboards for engineers and non-technical folks)
  • You are an excellent communicator with the ability to translate business asks into a technical language and vice versa
  • You are excited to leverage massive amounts of data to drive product innovation & deliver business value
  • You're familiar with math statistics (A/B-tests)

  • You are adept at fast prototyping and providing analytical support for initiatives in the e-commerce space by identifying & focusing on relevant features & metrics
  • You are willing to develop and maintain effective communication tools to report business performance and inform decision-making at a cross-functional level

Benefits

Profissional responsável por facilitar o planejamento e a execução de Program Increments (PI), liderando todas as fases dos projetos e promovendo a colaboração entre equipes multifuncionais.   • Apoiar a Execução das Iterações , facilitando eventos essenciais do ScrumXP, como refinamento do backlog, planejamento da iteração, reuniões diárias (daily stand-ups) e retrospectivas, garantindo alinhamento e progresso contínuo entre os sprints.

  • Melhorar o fluxo de trabalho estabelecendo e gerenciando o Kanban Board da equipe, medindo e otimizando a eficiência do fluxo e promovendo a qualidade integrada através dos princípios de Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) .

title: Technical Product Marketing Specialist
description:
Overview

Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world. We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single-tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.

Summary

As a Technical Product Marketing Specialist at Latitude.sh, you’ll bridge the gap between product, engineering, and marketing to accelerate the adoption of our global bare-metal platform. You’ll craft narratives and technical stories that resonate with infrastructure decision-makers — from developers and platform engineers to heads of cloud — translating complex infrastructure capabilities into clear, differentiated business value.

This role plays a key part in how we position and launch new technical capabilities, educate the market on why bare metal makes modern workloads succeed, and help customers understand how to build faster, more efficient platforms on top of Latitude.sh.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop technical narratives and enablement content (from guides and whitepapers to supporting the development of solution briefs, blog posts, and product pages) that articulate the value of our bare-metal solutions and accelerate user adoption.
  • Increase product awareness within the DevOps community and drive product adoption by expanding the user base and activating existing users.
  • Scale production of technical assets that showcase how our platform solves real-world problems in cloud infrastructure and across different verticals like Web3, AI/ML, SaaS, and edge computing.
  • Track and analyze product-marketing performance metrics to provide actionable insights that refine messaging, guide product strategy, and inform go-to-market priorities.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and networking teams to translate complex infrastructure features into clear customer-facing benefits across different content formats.
  • Develop and refine our technical personas, conduct surveys, and synthesize customer insights to inform product direction, feature prioritization, and messaging strategies.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistent storytelling, technical accuracy, and seamless execution of product marketing initiatives across campaigns, product releases, and customer touchpoints.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product marketing experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps platforms, or B2B technology (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, or similar technical products).
  • Strong project management skills with experience driving cross-functional launches and initiatives across product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to craft technical positioning and messaging that drives adoption and shapes market perception.
  • Analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience measuring success and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Highly self-motivated and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced, global, remote-first environment.
  • Hands-on experience creating and editing technical content (e.g., architecture diagrams, documentation, SDK/CLI guides, technical blog posts) is a strong plus.

What do we offer?

  • Contractor (PJ)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Wellhub (former Gympass)
  • Annual Bonus based on company and team performance
  • Work Anniversary bonus

Why Latitude.sh?

We\'re a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem-solving. As part of our team, you won\'t be lost in the crowd – you\'ll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.

Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We\'re proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, or disability. If these values speak to you, we\'d love for you to become a part of our team.

  • Experiência em liderança de equipes e interface com diferentes stakeholders, incluindo gestão de community manager, agências e creators.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver e executar planos de comunicação integrados (conteúdo, PR, social orgânica), alinhados aos objetivos do negócio.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes sociais, criação de conteúdo e estratégias para crescimento e engajamento de comunidades gamers e devs.
  • Perfil hands-on, com capacidade de planejar e executar ações, incluindo gerenciamento de cronogramas, budget (quando aplicável) e acompanhamento de métricas.
  • Inglês fluente, com segurança para produção de conteúdo, reuniões e contatos com stakeholders internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Organização, pensamento estruturado e visão analítica para interpretar dados e ajustar estratégias continuamente.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar e executar estratégias de go-to-market para lançamentos, novas features e SDKs, garantindo visibilidade e engajamento contínuo.
  • Liderar o trabalho da equipe e coordenar ações de comunicação, PR e social orgânica, alinhadas aos objetivos do projeto.
  • Gerenciar relacionamento com influenciadores, publishers, marcas parceiras e demais stakeholders para ampliar alcance e fortalecer a plataforma.
  • Construir e manter relacionamento com desenvolvedores, entendendo suas necessidades e produzindo conteúdos estratégicos (press releases, artigos, vídeos, social posts) voltados para gamedevs e gamers, garantindo consistência de mensagem e comunicação eficaz com a comunidade.
  • Participar de eventos e feiras relevantes do setor (GDC, DevCom/Gamescom, BIG Festival, entre outros), promovendo networking e visibilidade para o projeto.
  • Monitorar KPIs como wishlists, plays, envios de novos jogos e menções espontâneas, propondo melhorias com base em dados.
  • Garantir consistência do tom de voz e posicionamento da marca em todos os canais de comunicação.
  • Colaborar com Produto, Tech e demais áreas para alinhar estratégia de comunicação com o roadmap e as iniciativas da plataforma.

Importante : não deixe de aplicar caso não tenha todos os conhecimentos ou experiências acima! Sua capacidade de aprendizado e evolução é mais importante do que um checklist de conhecimentos e experiências prévias.

Modalidade e Faixa Salarial

A modalidade para essa posição é PJ , com faixa salarial aproximada de R$10.300,00 a R$11.150,00.

Power Ups

  • Plano de Saúde e Odonto : Cuidar da saúde não é brincadeira. Aqui você usufrui de um plano top de linha da AMIL com um desconto de apenas R$1 ao colaborador.
  • Ausência remunerada : 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa para você descansar, viajar, curtir a família, jogar a qualquer hora, etc.
  • Ajuda de Custo Mensal : Todo apoio é bem-vindo! Mensalmente oferecemos R$250,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios (categoria saldo livre) para nosso time estruturar seu ambiente de trabalho, uma internet de qualidade, home office e auxiliar nas contas de casa.
  • Crescimento Pessoal : Não queremos que você pare de aprender nunca! Por isso, todo colaborador tem o saldo de $70 dólares (aproximadamente R$345,00) por semestre para investir em seu crescimento profissional, seja em forma de curso, livro, workshop, eventos, etc…
  • 4 Days Off 4you : aqui na Nuuvem todo mundo ganha 4 dias de folga por ano para tirar quando você quiser…
  • Jogo do Mês : Se eu te contar que liberamos um item da nossa loja por mês para chamar de seu, você acredita? E sim, isso significa jogos totalmente grátis, você pode escolher qualquer título até R$ 360,00 :D Fácil assim e sem burocracia. Escolheu, jogou!
  • Cupom de 20% : Aí que a gente vê quem é amigo! Além do item do mês você ainda tem direito a 10 cupons de 20% na nossa loja anualmente para usar com você mesmo ou para dar de presente para amigos e familiares. A biblioteca de jogos agradece!
  • Open English : Quem nunca jogou um game em inglês, não é mesmo? Temos uma parceria super legal com a Open English para aprimorar o seu inglês e/ou espanhol!
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) : Ficar sentado no computador o dia todo não dá, né? :careta: Oferecemos acesso ao App Wellhub que tem convênio com diversas academia, estúdios e também inclui terapia, nutrição e treinos online.
  • AVUS : Porque saúde é prioridade para a Nuuvem! Com essa plataforma de benefícios, nosso time tem acesso a assistência virtual de alta qualidade e uma rede de profissionais em todo o Brasil, garantindo cuidados médicos personalizados a qualquer hora e lugar.
  • Starbem : Porque saúde mental é importante para nós! Aqui você tem acesso ao app Starbem com consultas médicas, psicológicas e nutricionais, além de descontos em farmácias sem custos adicionais!
  • Stay : Seu futuro tranquilo! Com nossa parceria, você investe nos seus sonhos de forma simples e prática, com flexibilidade para ajustar suas contribuições.

Procuram-se Sócios!

Programa de Stock Options : Por último, mas nada menos importante, aqui na Nuuvem você tem a chance de virar nosso sócio! Afinal, quem melhor entendedor da Nuuvem do que nosso próprio time? Sem pegadinhas, qualquer funcionário com pelo menos 1 ano de empresa já pode ser escolhido! A regra é clara: crescemos e ganhamos juntos!

Outros atrativos bem legais

  • Aniversariantes do Mês : Não é só mais um ano de vida que nossos aniversariantes ganham! Nosso evento online de aniversariantes conta com um saldo para todos os nuuveiros fazerem seus pedidos de delivery, brindes e atividades especiais, além de muita jogatina, óbvio!
  • Flexibilidade de horário : Cada um no seu quadrado! Sabemos que cada um tem suas rotinas e preferências em termos de horário e tentamos respeitar isso ao máximo. Damos flexibilidade para cada time escolher o horário que melhor se encaixe na rotina de seus integrantes, sejam os que acordam pro café da manhã ou pro almoço.
  • Encontros de Time : Não conseguimos ficar muito tempo longe uns dos outros hehe Por isso, anualmente, nosso time inteiro vem para a Cidade Maravilhosa, vulgo Rio de Janeiro, para um momento de interação ao vivo com toda a equipe Nuuvem.
  • Ambiente descontraído , extremamente colaborativo e com alta transparência : Queremos manter sempre nosso ambiente leve, onde todos têm acesso a todos e à todas as informações necessárias. Está em nosso sangue ser co-op. Estamos prontos para ajudar em qualquer ocasião!
  • Ações de endomarketing : mesmo distantes, gostamos de comemorar datas especiais como páscoa, festa junina, dia do gamer e outras, sempre garantindo um mimo para os nuuveiros!
  • Equipe Gamer : Aqui somos todos (ou quase todos) gamers! Entendemos e vivemos as dores de quem tem paixão pelos jogos e trabalhamos incessantemente para fazer o melhor para nossa comunidade. Se você não joga, não tem problema! Nossa equipe abraça gamers de longa data e futuros gamers igualmente ;)

Se identificou? PRESS START!

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role:

As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. Instead, it’s about deeply understanding each client’s needs, pitching our process, running intro calls, managing follow-ups, and ensuring a seamless transition into the matchmaking phase.

You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the full sales cycle for inbound agency search clients—from initial inquiry through signed engagement with our partners.
  • Conduct consultative sales calls to understand each client’s marketing needs and present Vendry’s search process.
  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

Vendry is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

Mid-Senior level

Full-time

title: Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Canonical has a large and rapidly growing kernel team that underpins Ubuntu and open source more widely across a range of hardware and use cases.

Job Description

We have opportunities for technical leadership, engineering management, and engineering directorships. The team is responsible for all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels, on all platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large scale cloud environments, mainframes and supercomputers.

Kernel Team projects include but are not limited to:

  • Ubuntu Linux kernel plan, execution, benchmarking and stress testing
  • Optimized kernels for key silicon and cloud partners
  • Confidential computing and next-generation security primitives
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Kernel Livepatch, which delivers critical kernel fixes without rebooting
  • FIPS compliance
  • Real-Time and Low Latency kernel variants and patch-sets
  • Virtualization or abstraction engines
  • Container technology
  • Security with AppArmor, SECCOMP, namespaces and more
  • Networking - in particular performance and security
  • Storage - we are particularly interested in Ceph and DRBD

Responsibilities

We hire candidates of all experience levels from recent university graduates through seasoned industry experts. You must have outstanding academic results, a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of a flavour of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

Requirements

We are looking for candidates with significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages. Experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages
  • Experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Solid background with git
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognize outstanding performance.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.

At LawnStarter, we're transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we're investing in the next generation of our platform—and we're looking for a Product Data Specialist to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your Primary Responsibility Will Be To Empower Our Organization To Be More Data-driven, And There Are Many Ways To Accomplish That, Such As

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with various moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an extremely exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analysis and models we need have different degrees of complexity, from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. We expect you to have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R
  • Reporting: If a complex system creates an exciting pool of opportunities, it also creates a high number of metrics that we need to keep track of to run the business efficiently. However, a dashboard is only as good as our trust in being correct and updated. It's your responsibility to understand the needs of the teams you'll be working with and help the Analytics team create and maintain our reporting system, keeping it organized and user-friendly. For that, you'll be mainly using Tableau and Metabase
  • Analytics Engineering: Although it won't be your main focus, occasionally, you will need to work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets to empower our reports and end users within the organization. Understanding the business needs and consolidating them into our DW is crucial to maintaining a reliable single source of truth. We use DBT for the data transformation, so SQL experience is a must

Requirements

  • Experience: You have 4+ years of experience in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: You have a STEM or business background or relevant education that makes you suited to empower our organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions. You can absorb a variety of topics with extreme ease, having a structured and logical approach to developing your understanding of the business and its challenges. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique
  • Team player: You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on each
  • Bias for action: You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems and identifying opportunities, you actively try to avoid being a perfectionist or getting yourself tied up in knots. You have a bias for action in order to make progress. You enjoy being scrappy and constraints enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go

  • Flexible hours—get the work done on your schedule

title: Accounting Manager/ Controller
description:
Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for an Accounting Manager/ Controller!

Note to Applicants:

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Manager to join our growing offshore team. The ideal candidate will oversee the full accounting cycle for multiple high-growth startup clients, manage month-end close and reconciliations, ensure GAAP-compliant financial reporting, and lead day-to-day client accounting operations including AP, AR, payroll, and revenue recognition. They will also guide and review the work of client teams, maintain consistent accounting policies, and partner closely with startup executives to provide financial insights and recommendations.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary accounting lead and controller for 2–3 large, high-growth startup clients.
  • Manage and review monthly close processes, including balance sheet and P&L reconciliations (prepaid expenses, fixed assets, accrued liabilities, deferred revenue, etc.).
  • Oversee core accounting functions such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, inventory, and revenue recognition.
  • Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting, delivering GAAP-compliant financial statements and management reports.
  • Partner directly with startup executive teams (CEOs, CFOs, VPs of Finance) to provide insights, recommendations, and proactive financial support.
  • Maintain consistent accounting policies and procedures across clients, documenting best practices to ensure scalability and efficiency.
  • Manage the day-to-day workflow of your dedicated client teams, reviewing their work and ensuring quality deliverables.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within Furey to continuously improve client processes and enhance service delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA or equivalent designation preferred). MBA would be a plus
  • 15+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally with exposure to high-growth startups, venture-backed companies, or outsourced accounting (at least 3 years of experience with an accounting firm is required)
  • 5+ years experience in a manager position
  • Fluency in English (written and verbal) required
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and technical accounting concepts.
  • Proven experience leading month-end close and producing accurate financial statements.
  • Hands-on expertise with accounting systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar) and strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and project management skills with the ability to handle multiple clients simultaneously.
  • Strong client relationship skills and ability to communicate effectively with startup executives.
  • Experience in Inventory and Cost Accounting

Nice to Haves

  • Work experience at one of the big four US accounting firms (KPMG, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Deloitte, Ernst & Young)
  • Ability to create or improve processes. We’re a fast-paced startup and don’t always have lengthy process documentation available.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Unlimited Paid Days Off + 14 paid federal holidays per calendar year
  • Time zone & Working hours: Monday to Thursday 9 am - 6 pm, and Friday 9 am - 1 pm EST.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding-edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan, have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES

  • 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
  • Proven ability to build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
  • Experience in building subscription-based products with a track record of driving growth;
  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
  • A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Deep understanding of gaming trends;
  • Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, your primary responsibility is to your team: helping them grow as engineers, do important and satisfying work, and have a great time while doing it. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role.

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution

    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

Cientista de Dados Pleno | Preferencial para Mulheres

Sua carreira com liberdade e propósito. Você sabia que 93% das 21 milhões de empresas do Brasil são pequenos e médios negócios? Apesar de serem responsáveis por ⅓ do PIB do país e gerar 60% dos empregos, as PMEs não são o foco da maioria das instituições financeiras.

Isso muda com a Cora, um banco digital dedicado exclusivamente a pequenas e médias empresas brasileiras. Buscamos apoiar e simplificar a rotina de pequenas e médias empresas, libertando pessoas empreendedoras das papeladas e taxas abusivas dos bancos tradicionais. Com 5 anos de existência, já somamos mais de 300 pessoas trabalhando de forma remota em vários lugares do Brasil para simplificar a rotina de mais de 1 milhão clientes em todo o país.

Buscamos por pessoas dispostas a construir a Cora que queremos. Vem trabalhar com a gente?

Qual vai ser seu dia a dia como Cientista de Dados Pleno por aqui?

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar modelos de Machine Learning para detecção de fraudes, utilizando Python e frameworks relevantes;
  • Realizar análises estatísticas aprofundadas dos dados transacionais e comportamentais para identificar padrões de fraude emergentes;
  • Otimizar continuamente os modelos existentes para melhorar a precisão e reduzir falsos positivos, além de monitorar seu desempenho em produção;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de engenharia, produto e segurança para implementar soluções de combate à fraude eficazes e escaláveis;
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados automatizados para garantir a disponibilidade e qualidade dos dados para modelagem;
  • Comunicar os resultados das análises e modelos de forma clara e concisa para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos, documentando o processo de ponta a ponta;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as últimas tendências em Machine Learning e combate à fraude, explorando novas técnicas e tecnologias para melhorar as soluções existentes.

O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time?

  • Experiência de 2+ anos em ciência de dados, com foco em Machine Learning e análise estatística;
  • Experiência com projetos de combate à fraude;
  • Domínio da linguagem Python e de bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, etc;
  • Experiência prática com algoritmos de Machine Learning para classificação, regressão e clustering, e suas aplicações em detecção de anomalias e fraude;
  • Familiaridade com serviços da AWS para armazenamento, processamento e implantação de modelos (ex: S3, EC2, SageMaker);
  • Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines de dados utilizando Apache Airflow;
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados, incluindo modelagem relacional e não relacional;
  • Forte capacidade analítica para identificar padrões em grandes conjuntos de dados e derivar insights acionáveis;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita para apresentar resultados e colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares.

O que oferecemos:

  • Benefícios flexíveis no cartão Flash;
  • Trabalho 100% Remoto
  • Plano de Saúde 100% custeado pela Cora (com inclusão de dependentes)
  • Plano Odontológico (Desconto de pequeno valor em folha)
  • Auxílio Aprendizagem de R$ 3.000 por ano para cursos, livros, pós graduação, etc (para profissionais em início de carreira, o benefício é de R$ 4.000)
  • Licença parental estendida para gestantes e não gestantes
  • Parceria com Gympass e Zenklub
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Estrutura para home office: fornecimento de equipamento completo (notebook com suporte, monitor extra, teclado e mouse), possibilidade de compra de cadeira, escrivaninha e apoio para pé;
  • Auxílio home office mensal;
  • Convênio com a plataforma Woba para você poder trabalhar em vários Coworkings em todo o Brasil

Fazemos algumas perguntas já nesse primeiro momento pensando em agilizar o seu processo. Se quiser saber mais sobre como usamos os dados, pode conferir nossa Política de Privacidade aqui.

Ser um LMer é muito mais do que ser um funcionário da empresa LM Soluções de Mobilidade; é fazer parte de uma organização colaborativa onde todos têm espaço para se desenvolver e compartilhar o melhor de si.

Somos uma empresa impulsionada por pessoas, por isso, nosso jeito de Ser e Fazer é fundamentalmente direcionado a como nos relacionamos com todos ao nosso redor: entre funcionários, parceiros, fornecedores, investidores e clientes.

Por aqui, valorizamos pessoas curiosas, que buscam aprender sempre e atuam com protagonismo e sentimento de dono, seja na carreira, em um projeto específico ou nas atividades.

Em 2025, completamos 50 anos de experiência no setor, escrevendo uma história de excelência e qualidade e abraçando as necessidades dos nossos clientes. Nossa atuação é em todo o território nacional e temos filiais em 8 localidades, além da nossa matriz, em Salvador-BA!

Nossa atuação e comprometimento em transformar estratégias em resultados nos abriu portas para fazer parte do Grupo Volkswagen, potencializando ainda mais nosso alcance e reiterando nosso jeito de ser e fazer, pautado na ética, respeito e colaboração, que nos trouxe até aqui.

SOBRE A LM SOLUÇÕES DE MOBILIDADE

Há mais de 40 anos trabalhamos com foco em ser a melhor solução de mobilidade para pessoas e empresas. A LM Soluções de Mobilidade nasceu na Bahia através da veia empreendedora do seu fundador, Luiz Mendonça Filho, que transformou a empresa em uma das principais referências no setor, com atuação em todo o Brasil.

Além da experiência e domínio da operação, tão característica da LM ao longo dos anos, temos a segurança e a solidez de uma das marcas mais valiosas do mundo.

Hoje com a LM Soluções de Mobilidade oferecemos produtos e serviços totalmente personalizados para atender a necessidade de cada cliente, seja em terceirização de frotas, assinatura de veículos, venda de seminovos, aluguel para motorista de aplicativo ou mesmo assinatura de caminhões.

Job description

E sabe o que buscamos nas pessoas que vão se juntar ao nossO Time?

Estamos em busca de profissionais que valorizem autonomia, responsabilidade, trabalho em time, aprendizado constante, colaboração, comunicação, e claro, proximidade e transparência! Se você se identifica com esse tipo de ambiente, já estamos começando a dar match !

Consideramos única e especial cada pessoa do nosso time, por isso todas são bem vindas, temos um ambiente seguro para os áureos e áureas se expressarem do jeito que são.

Dentro do time de Tecnologia sua missão será: Orquestrar a operação tática de múltiplos squads para transformar a estratégia de Tecnologia em entregas previsíveis, seguras e de alto valor ao negócio, padronizando rituais e métricas, removendo impedimentos e garantindo visibilidade executiva, viabilizando o CTO a atuar focado em nível estratégico.

Ah, uma informação importante sobre essa vaga: o modelo de trabalho proposto é remoto .

Main responsibilities

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

  • Desdobrar OKRs em planos táticos trimestrais e roadmaps integrados; gerenciar calendário de releases; facilitar priorização e gerir dependências entre squads; e conduzir ritos táticos (planning, review, retro, check semanal), garantindo DoR/DoD claros.
  • Padronizar e evoluir o fluxo atrelado às esteiras de desenvolvimento de produto; reduzir retrabalho e lead time; garantir qualidade de releases (gate de release, go/no-go, checklist) e integração com CI/CD e performance; estruturar e acompanhar planos de hardening e redução de débito técnico.
  • Facilitar e apoiar planejamento para automação de testes, cobertura e ambientes de QA; definir SLIs/SLOs com SRE; operar o ciclo de incidentes com CloudOps, SecOps (detecção, resposta, post-mortem e ações corretivas) e TIC; melhorar MTTR/MTBF; incorporar práticas DevSecOps e conformidade (LGPD/ISO/NIST/CIS) no SDLC.
  • Monitorar custo de infra vs. adoção/usuários ativos; promover otimizações e planejamento de capacidade; acompanhar orçamento tático de tecnologia e variações relevantes; apoiar compras/renovações.
  • Manter dashboard tático com throughput, lead/cycle time, bugs por release, disponibilidade, custos, risco e progresso de OKRs; conduzir análises de causa-raiz e planos de melhoria contínua; reportar status e riscos ao CTO.
  • Fazer 1:1s com coordenações/tech leads; dar feedbacks, apoiar trilhas de carreira e sucessão; apoiar atração, seleção e onboarding; fomentar cultura de colaboração, segurança e aprendizagem.
  • Gerenciar RACI, playbooks (SDLC, change management, incidentes), catálogo de serviços e SLAs/SLIs/SLOs; zelar pela documentação viva e pela aderência aos processos acordados.
  • Alinhar prioridades com Produto, CX, Jurídico e áreas de negócio; gerir expectativas com comunicação clara e sem surpresas; conduzir comitês/cerimônias de decisão quando necessário.

Requirements and skills

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

Formação

Sempre que possível, Graduação completa em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência/Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência

  • 7+ anos no ecossistema de desenvolvimento/operações de software;
  • 3+ anos em gestão direta de times e líderes técnicos (coordenações/tech leads);
  • Atuação prévia liderando equipes em negócios de modelo SaaS; e
  • Atuação com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, CX, jurídico, segurança) e gestão de mudanças organizacionais.

Conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

  • SDLC ponta a ponta e rituais ágeis (planning, review, retro) com DoR/DoD claros.
  • CI/CD com gates de qualidade, versionamento, gestão de mudanças e calendário de releases.
  • Cloud (preferencialmente GCP) e práticas de SRE/observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces; SLIs/SLOs).
  • DevSecOps e resposta a incidentes (post-mortem, planos de ação) com noções de LGPD, ISO 27001 e CIS.
  • Capacidade de construir e operar dashboards táticos (engenharia, qualidade, confiabilidade e FinOps básico: custo vs. uso/usuário).

Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação executiva e clareza na gestão de stakeholders.
  • Priorização orientada a valor, pensamento sistêmico e tomada de decisão data-driven.
  • Gestão de conflitos, facilitação de ritos e senso de urgência em incidentes.
  • Liderança de líderes (feedbacks, 1:1s, desenvolvimento de carreira).

Ferramentas e idiomas

  • Vivência com ferramentas de gestão do trabalho (ex.: Jira), documentação viva e observabilidade/APM.
  • Inglês técnico e avançado (leitura/escrita e conversação em contexto profissional).

É um diferencial se você tiver:

Experiência setorial

  • Vivência em SaaS B2B de alta disponibilidade; desejável legaltech e integrações com órgãos públicos.
  • Histórico de melhoria de previsibilidade e qualidade com métricas (ex.: lead/cycle time, throughput, bugs por release, SLO/MTTR).

Arquitetura e desenvolvimento

  • Kubernetes/GKE, Terraform/IaC, service mesh, feature flags, blue/green/canary;
  • Arquitetura event-driven (Pub/Sub, Kafka), microsserviços (Java/Spring, 0 Node.js), caching e performance; e
  • Esteiras CI/CD avançadas (gates de qualidade, security scanning, release automation).

SRE, observabilidade e confiabilidade

  • Definição e operação de SLIs/SLOs/Error Budgets.

Segurança e conformidade

  • Familiaridade com LGPD, ISO 27001/27002 ou CIS Controls e resposta a incidentes com comunicação a clientes; e
  • Experiência com IAM de nuvem e políticas de least privilege.

Dados, IA e automação

  • Pipelines ETL/ELT (data build tool, BigQuery) e governança de dados; e
  • Automação/RPA e aplicações de IA em produtividade/observabilidade/qualidade (ex.: code review assistido).

Gestão, métricas e FinOps

  • Modelagem de OKRs em múltiplos níveis e métricas de fluxo (lead/cycle time, WIP, throughput).
  • FinOps (tagueamento de custos, chargeback/showback, rightsizing e reservas/compromissos).

  • Experience working closely with commercial or marketing teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building checkout, billing, or payment flows (and tracking the usage of users).
  • Familiarity with web analytics tools.
  • Ability to improve existing design system or reusable component library.
  • Background working in startups or fast-paced environments.
  • Intermediate or higher English fluency.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a data analysis, analytics engineering, or BI role with exposure to financial and SaaS metrics.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and transforming datasets.
  • Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of SaaS business models and unit economics.
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills for modeling and analysis.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in SaaS finance or FP&A teams.
  • Familiarity with ERP/accounting systems (Omie, NetSuite, QuickBooks, etc.).
  • Experience integrating APIs from CRMs, ERPs, and billing platforms.
  • Background in statistics, economics, or data science.
  • Experience working in startups or high-growth companies.

  • Understanding of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with task queues for managing background jobs.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to optimizing cloud spend.

Benefits

Black Dragon Capital is a minority-controlled, growth-driven private equity fund created by technology operating executives with a track record of creating market-leading companies and an impressive investment return history. Our Vision

At Swapcard, we believe in the power of meaningful connections. This belief fuels our commitment to pioneering modern solutions that empower organizers to create engaging event experiences.

Guided by our commitment to excellence and collaboration, we aim to redefine the landscape of event technology, setting new standards for engagement, accessibility, and impact.

Our Beliefs

At Swapcard, diversity is at the core of our success. With 42 nationalities represented among our 180+ team members, we champion diversity as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and unparalleled innovation.

We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants.

Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Owner to join our squad focused on delivering the best on-site event experience . This development team is responsible for:

  • Floor plans features, including geolocation (outdoor & indoor Positioning)
  • Integrations and collaboration with external maps and indoor positioning providers
  • The entire login and onboarding experience within the event app

As a Product Owner, you’ll drive your squad of dedicated developers and work hand-in-hand with product designers. You’ll define the product vision, set priorities, and make sure the solutions we deliver meet real customer needs.

From roadmap planning to final delivery, you’ll own the entire feature journey. This includes engaging directly with clients, running UX research, and writing clear product specifications. Data and insights will guide your decisions, helping you validate assumptions, prioritize effectively, and measure success.

What are we looking for?

  • 4+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product role
  • Strong analytical mindset with proven ability to make data-driven decisions
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a proactive attitude
  • Excellent prioritization skills, with a clear focus on customer impact
  • Experience engaging directly with clients, conducting research, and co-building solutions
  • Strong collaboration skills, comfortable working with developers, designers, and stakeholders
  • Empathetic, people-first approach to teamwork and leadership
  • Experience with floor plan features or a background in software engineering is a strong plus
  • Fluency in English

Why Join us?

  • Be part of a global, international team in a scale-up company
  • Lead your own squad with developers and designers dedicated to your product area
  • Shape the future of on-site event experiences in a company leading the EventTech industry
  • Work remotely with flexibility, or access offices through Spaces worldwide

  1. Screening Interview with a recruiter from our people team.
  2. A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.
  3. Manager review with your future reporting manager
  4. Leadership review with one of our department leaders
  5. Reference check conducted by our people team
  6. Offer

Swapcard's Values

Curious : We ask questions, try new things and take risks. We learn from one another and see mistakes as opportunities to grow—what matters most is how we react and learn from them. We are curious about what something is and why something is. Innovation thrives when curiosity drives.

Value-Driven: At Swapcard, we focus on making each decision count by prioritising outcomes that create meaningful value for our customers, team members, and partners.

Human : At Swapcard, being human means fostering empathy, openness, and diversity to create a caring and collaborative community. We’re driven by a strong team spirit and a shared goal of building meaningful connections—both through our product and within our team.

Resilient : We embrace challenges with optimism, creativity, and adaptability, constantly seeking innovative solutions and opportunities for growth.

Ownership: At Swapcard, we take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability. True ownership means more than just completing tasks; it's about being proactive, investing ourselves fully in the outcomes, and fostering a culture of trust.

Benefits & Reasons to Join Swapcard

  • Remote-first policy with headquarters in Paris
  • Thriving startup with career growth opportunities
  • Open-minded culture that appreciates differences

Equal Opportunity

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Tecnologia [Preferencial para Pessoas Negras]
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Quer estar ao lado de professores e, junto com eles, impulsionar a Educação pública do Brasil?

Aqui, a transformação já está acontecendo, e você pode fazer parte disso!

Se imagina num ambiente colaborativo, inovador e cheio de propósito ? Quer trabalhar com um time que valoriza a diversidade, promove a inclusão e acredita na potência de cada pessoa?

Somos juntos e diversos.

Acreditamos que diferentes trajetórias e pontos de vista se complementam e fortalecem tudo o que fazemos, tanto com os educadores do Brasil quanto no nosso dia a dia.

Por isso, valorizamos candidaturas de Pessoas com deficiência, Pessoas negras, Pessoas Indigenas, Pessoas LGBTQIAPN+, Pessoas 45+ e Mulheres.

Sobre a Área de Inovação e o time de tecnologia:

Na área de Inovação, nossa missão é criar soluções e experiências que transformem e potencializem o aprendizado dos educadores. Nossa equipe é composta pelos times de produto, design de produto, dados, marketing de produto e tecnologia. Juntos, combinamos o conhecimento dos professores, insights de mercado, análise de dados e paixão para atuar com agilidade, testar e desenvolver tanto soluções inovadoras quanto evoluir as nossas soluções atuais.

Nossas principais apostas hoje estão em experiências WhatsApp-first e no uso de inteligência artificial generativa para apoiar professores no dia a dia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Buscamos uma pessoa Coordenadora de Tecnologia para ser a liderança técnica mais sênior do time, responsável por definir e evoluir a arquitetura do site e do WhatsApp, garantindo soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e de baixo custo. Essa posição é estratégica para integrar IA generativa, orquestração de agentes e RAG, ao mesmo tempo em que assegura performance, governança e impacto educacional.

Liderança e gestão do time interno e times externos:

  • Liderar e orientar as pessoas desenvolvedoras promovendo um ambiente de colaboração e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Gerenciar de forma eficaz os processos de desenvolvimento de software e os recursos de tecnologia.
  • Gerenciar e priorizar vários projetos simultaneamente alocando recursos de forma eficiente, otimizando processos e garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Supervisionar a execução de projetos por equipes terceirizadas, assegurando que estejam alinhadas com as expectativas e metas da empresa.
  • Gerenciar relacionamentos com fornecedores, monitorando o desempenho, garantindo que os contratos sejam cumpridos e identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Avaliar e selecionar fornecedores externos, considerando a qualidade, custo e alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Colaborar com o time interno para integrar eficazmente soluções de fornecedores externos em nossa infraestrutura e processos internos.
  • Desenvolver e manter um ambiente de trabalho positivo, promovendo a colaboração, comunicação e desenvolvimento de habilidades da equipe.

Inovação Tecnológica:

  • Conduzir o processo de concepção, arquitetura e desenvolvimento de provas de conceito, especialmente em IA e WhatsApp-first.
  • Liderar a definição da arquitetura de sistemas, equilibrando escalabilidade, desempenho, segurança, custos e usabilidade.
  • Avaliar e selecionar modelos de IA, vetores, ferramentas de mensageria e frameworks mais adequados para cada projeto, garantindo agnosticidade e sustentabilidade.
  • Estabelecer padrões, diretrizes e iniciativas de melhoria contínua no desenvolvimento de software.
  • Manter-se atualizado com tendências em IA, infraestrutura cloud e mensageria, fornecendo direção estratégica para a equipe.
  • Explorar quando fizer sentido tecnologias no-code e low-code para acelerar prototipação e reduzir tempo de entrega.

Colaboração e Estratégia:

  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outras áreas para coordenar projetos e alinhar metas de negócios.
  • Colaborar de forma integrada com os times de dados e produto na definição de estratégias e na criação de uma visão tecnológica consistente.
  • Desenvolver roadmaps tecnológicos que direcionam nosso caminho a médio e longo prazo.
  • Ser referência técnica para a liderança e contribuir com decisões estratégicas da organização.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Os requisitos essenciais para esta posição incluem:

  • Experiência comprovada em liderança de equipe e gestão de processos.
  • Vivência prática em IA generativa (LLMs, embeddings, RAG, agentes orquestrados) e conhecimento de frameworks de multiagentes.
  • Experiência em WhatsApp/Meta API
  • Conhecimento avançado em Node.js e stacks/frameworks de front end (preferencialmente React).
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, incluindo metodologias ágeis.
  • Experiência com infraestrutura AWS e cultura devops
  • Habilidade em identificar problemas técnicos e de processo e trabalhar com a equipe para resolvê-los.
  • Capacidade de aprender rapidamente novas tecnologias e processos.
  • Habilidades interpessoais, incluindo habilidades em gestão de pessoas, motivação e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Disposição para aprender e se desenvolver na Nova Escola.

Caso você cumpra a maioria, mas não todos os requisitos para a vaga, não deixe de se candidatar. Podemos conversar para te conhecer melhor e entender se conseguimos te apoiar nas aprendizagens necessárias!

  • Experiência pessoal ou profissional com educação pública.
  • Interesse em trabalhar com propósito.
  • Experiência com ecossistemas open source de IA

Cuidar de quem cuida

Aqui na Nova Escola, acreditamos que só conseguimos apoiar os professores do Brasil se também cuidarmos bem de quem está por trás dessa missão. Por isso, criamos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar o seu bolso, sua saúde, seu desenvolvimento e, claro, seus momentos de descanso.

Para o seu bolso e rotina

  • CLT com horário flexível (40h semanais)
  • Participação nos Resultados (até 4 salários)
  • Vale-refeição de R$39,71/dia útil no cartão Flash
  • Auxílio home office mensal
  • Auxílio creche para crianças até 7 anos

️ Para sua saúde e bem-estar

  • Plano de saúde Amil (apartamento) com 50% para dependentes
  • Wellhub (Gympass) com acesso a academias, apps de meditação e bem-estar
  • Licenças estendidas de maternidade e paternidade

Para seu desenvolvimento

  • Apoio financeiro para cursos e formações
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento para pessoas negras
  • Desconto em escolas de inglês
  • Participação em eventos e trilhas de aprendizagem internas

Para inclusão e pertencimento

  • Grupos de afinidade para pessoas negras (Afroaners), pessoas LGBTQIAPN+ (POC Escola) e para pessoas que exercem papel de parentalidade (Rede de cuidadores)
  • Encontros, rodas de conversa e ações de letramento promovidas pelo comitê de diversidade.
  • Ambiente seguro e acolhedor para trocas e construção conjunta.

Para recarregar as energias

  • Day off no aniversário
  • Recesso coletivo de fim de ano (10 dias de descanso garantido)

Faça parte do time que está transformando a Educação pública do país!

  • Step 2: Entrevista com Gente&Gestão 2 Entrevista com Gente&Gestão
  • Step 3: Entrevista com Pares e Liderados 3 Entrevista com Pares e Liderados
  • Step 4: Entrevista com a Liderança 4 Entrevista com a Liderança

Conheça a Nova Escola

A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil

Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.

Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. Nosso principal mantenedor é a Fundação Lemann e realizamos parcerias com diversas organizações como Google.org , Facebook, Fundação Itaú Social, Imaginable Futures, Governo Britânico, secretarias de educação e outras organizações que nos ajudam nesse desafio.

64% dos professores brasileiros utilizam nossos planos de aula todos os meses, além disso temos 3 milhões de visitantes únicos por mês em nossa plataforma e cerca de 1,8 milhões de seguidores em nossas redes sociais, o que nos permite conhecer bem nosso público.

Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!

Trabalhamos com

O Educador no centro: Para nós, a transformação acontece através das professoras e professores de escola pública. Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.

Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.

Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Juntos e Diversos: Para nós, a diversidade, a inclusão e os conhecimentos multidisciplinares são pilares fundamentais para as nossas práticas, tanto nas ações que desenvolvemos com/para os educadores do Brasil quanto em iniciativas internas. Acreditamos que pessoascom diferentes trajetórias e pontos de vistase complementam e podem compartilhar um mesmo propósito. Pensamos juntos para pensar maior.

Atitude Responsável: Para nós, agir com responsabilidade é uma prática contínua, tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação.Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.

Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazerperguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimorar nossos processos.
